description: A React component for displaying a list of student certificates, including features for previewing and exporting certificates as PNG or PDF. It utilizes mock data, handles user interactions for viewing and downloading certificates, and manages modal dialogs for certificate previews.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a date string into a locale-specific date format with fallback.

methods.name: handleOpenPreview
methods.description: Sets the certificate to be previewed, opening the modal.

methods.name: handleDownloadPng
methods.description: Exports the certificate preview as a PNG file.

methods.name: handleDownloadPdf
methods.description: Exports the certificate preview as a PDF file.

methods.name: slugify
methods.description: Converts a string into a URL-friendly slug.
